en.title: Sandboxed Example Extension
en.description: The example extension, written as a sandboxed extension: a working reference for third-party developers.
en.setting-greeting-description: The greeting shown by this extension's example tool.
en.setting-greetingSize-description: How large the greeting is, in rem. 1 is normal text size, and decimals like 1.25 work.
en.setting-subtitle-description: Optional line shown under the greeting. This setting declares no default, so nothing shows until you set one.
en.setting-showBanner-description: Whether to show the example banner.
en.setting-repeatCount-description: How many times to repeat the greeting. A whole number from 1 to 10.
en.setting-exampleClientId-description: Sent in the body of requests to the example service.
en.setting-exampleApiKey-description: Sent as a bearer token to the example service.
en.send-sensitive-request: Send a request with the sensitive settings
en.example-banner: This is the example banner. Turn it off in this extension's settings.
en.portal-permission-declined: Showing a CasualOS portal needs your permission.
